description: This file defines the OrderFacade interface which provides a contract for order-related operations in the e-commerce system, including order initialization, calculation, processing, validation, retrieval, and shipping details.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Initializes a new ShopOrder for a given merchant store, customer, shopping cart, and language.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Updates or recalculates the given ShopOrder based on current customer, store, shopping cart, and language data.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of an order, with overloads for website and API usage.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes a valid order, with method overloads to include a transaction for initial payment processing.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates an empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries available for shipping based on store and language.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates a shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language, with overload for customer object.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary from a shipping quote for order total calculations.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates the order object, populating validation messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a readable order object by order ID for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList
methods.description: Fetches a list of readable orders for a customer or store with pagination parameters.
